verdict.rationale: Kino runs a local MCP server that lets external agents edit projects and streams clips from its cloud, so documenting its security posture is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of what skills or agents can execute, any trust model for third-party integrations, or telemetry and data-collection practices. "No account needed" is not a security-posture disclosure.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection
